description: Fork of exp716 (1.3086 @ step 200, no-warmup hard finetune of exp710 — too perturbed at peak LR). Single change: peak_lr_scale=0.5 (multiplies the whole cosine schedule by 0.5). Effective LR: starts at 0.5*peak (adam=1.5e-4, lut=1e-4), cosine decays to 0.05*peak floor (adam=1.5e-5, lut=1e-5). No warmup. Hypothesis: peak LR (1.0) shatters soft optimum (exp716 step 200 = 1.3086, far worse than exp715 step 200 = 1.2802). Half-peak gives milder hardening pressure that may preserve more soft structure. All other config identical to exp716 (fork exp710 ckpt, backward_mode='soft', bs=48, 4K steps).
